meta.note: Every number here came from news reports and tenant-info sites, not the ordinance text. Verify against newarknj.gov or the Newark rent control office, then set verified=true and put the date in rulesLastChecked.

rentControl.status: VERIFY: cap is the lower of 4% or CPI. Put the current CPI figure in cpiPercent once confirmed.

unconscionable.status: VERIFY: 2023 ordinance. Fine is $1,200 (city) or $1,250 (Gothamist) - sources conflict.
